Package io.webagent4j.locator.internal

Class LocatorDiagnosticsAccumulator

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.locator.internal.LocatorDiagnosticsAccumulator
public final class LocatorDiagnosticsAccumulator extends Object
Bounded mutable accumulator owned by exactly one resolution attempt.
